---
title: Trading Styles
description: The 8 trading styles and which panels each can access.
---

Every trader has exactly one trading style. The style determines which panels they can access.

## Style → panel matrix

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED panel-matrix · do not edit · regenerated by docs/site/scripts/generate-panel-matrix.mjs from frontend/src/components/dashboard/panelRegistry.ts -->

| Panel | high_touch | low_touch | fi_voice | fx_electronic | commodities_voice | derivatives_high_touch | derivatives_low_touch | oversight |
|-------|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|
| Algo Leaderboard (strategy performance) | No | Yes | No | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Algo Monitor (strategy status) | No | Yes | No | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Basket Order (multi-leg) | Yes | No | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Decision Log (algo audit trail) | No | Yes | No | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Duration Ladder (DV01 by tenor) | No | No | Yes | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Greeks Surface (strike profile) | No | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Option Pricing (Black-Scholes) | No | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Order Ticket (place trades) | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Price Fan (GBM projection) | No | No | Yes | No | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| Scenario Matrix (spot/vol shocks) | No | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Spread Analysis (G/Z/OAS) | No | No | Yes | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Vol Surface (implied vol smile) | No | No | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Volatility Profile (EWMA trend) | No | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yield Curve (Nelson-Siegel) | No | No | Yes | No | No | No | No | Yes |

<!-- END GENERATED panel-matrix -->

Panels not listed (market-ladder, candle-chart, news, blotter, etc.) are accessible to all trading styles.

## Default workspaces

| Style | Default workspace |
|-------|-------------------|
| `high_touch` | Trading |
| `low_touch` | Algo |
| `fi_voice` | FI Trading |
| `fx_electronic` | Algo |
| `commodities_voice` | Commodities |
| `derivatives_high_touch` | Options |
| `derivatives_low_touch` | Algo |
| `oversight` | Trading |
